"qwen3:4b-instruct":(1790866194,{"keep_alive":"30m","num_ctx":8192}),
}
c=sqlite3.connect(os.environ["DB"]); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
c.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
after={}
try:
 for mid,(updated,fields) in expected.items():
  r=c.execute("select id,name,base_model_id,params,is_active,updated_at from model where id=?",(mid,)).fetchone()
  if not r: raise RuntimeError("CAS_ABORT missing "+mid)
  d=dict(r); p=json.loads(d["params"] or "{}")
  if d["is_active"]!=1 or int(d["updated_at"])!=updated: raise RuntimeError("CAS_ABORT version "+mid)
  for k,v in fields.items():
   if p.get(k)!=v: raise RuntimeError("CAS_ABORT field "+mid+" "+k)
  for k in fields: p.pop(k,None)
  newp=json.dumps(p,separators=(",",":"))
  now=int(time.time())
  c.execute("update model set params=?, updated_at=? where id=? and updated_at=?",(newp,now,mid,updated))
  if c.rowcount!=1: raise RuntimeError("CAS_ABORT update "+mid)
  after[mid]={"removed":sorted(fields),"params":p,"updated_at":now}
 c.commit()
except Exception:
 c.rollback(); raise

 c.close()
